verses.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת זְכוֹר־יְהוָ֥ה לְדָוִ֑ד אֵ֝ת כָּל־עֻנּוֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: A Song of Ascents. LORD, remember unto David All his affliction;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭שְׁבַּע לַיהוָ֑ה נָ֝דַ֗ר לַאֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.en: How he swore unto the LORD, And vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:

verses.he: אִם־אָ֭בֹא בְּאֹ֣הֶל בֵּיתִ֑י אִם־אֶ֝עֱלֶ֗ה עַל־עֶ֥רֶשׂ יְצוּעָֽי׃
verses.en: ‘Surely I will not come into the tent of my house, Nor go up into the bed that is spread for me;
I will not give sleep to mine eyes, Nor slumber to mine eyelids;

verses.he: עַד־אֶמְצָ֣א מָ֭קוֹם לַיהוָ֑ה מִ֝שְׁכָּנ֗וֹת לַאֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.en: Until I find out a place for the LORD, A dwelling-place for the Mighty One of Jacob.'
Lo, we heard of it as being in Ephrath; We found it in the field of athe wood.
Let us go into His dwelling-place; Let us worship at His footstool. .

verses.he: קוּמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לִמְנוּחָתֶ֑ךָ אַ֝תָּ֗ה וַאֲר֥וֹן עֻזֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: Arise, O LORD, unto Thy resting-place; Thou, and the ark of Thy strength.
Let Thy priests be clothed with righteousness; And let Thy saints shout for joy.

verses.he: בַּ֭עֲבוּר דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ אַל־תָּ֝שֵׁ֗ב פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: For Thy servant David's sake Turn not away the face of Thine anointed.

verses.he: נִשְׁבַּֽע־יְהוָ֨ה׀ לְדָוִ֡ד אֱמֶת֮ לֹֽא־יָשׁ֪וּב מִ֫מֶּ֥נָּה מִפְּרִ֥י בִטְנְךָ֑ אָ֝שִׁ֗ית לְכִסֵּא־לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: The LORD swore unto David in truth; He will not turn back from it: 'Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

verses.he: אִֽם־יִשְׁמְר֬וּ בָנֶ֨יךָ׀ בְּרִיתִי֮ וְעֵדֹתִ֥י ז֗וֹ אֲלַ֫מְּדֵ֥ם גַּם־בְּנֵיהֶ֥ם עֲדֵי־עַ֑ד יֵ֝שְׁב֗וּ לְכִסֵּא־לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: If thy children keep My covenant And My testimony that I shall teach them, Their children also for ever shall sit upon thy throne.'

verses.he: כִּֽי־בָחַ֣ר יְהוָ֣ה בְּצִיּ֑וֹן אִ֝וָּ֗הּ לְמוֹשָׁ֥ב לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for His habitation:
'This is My resting-place for ever; Here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

verses.he: צֵ֭ידָהּ בָּרֵ֣ךְ אֲבָרֵ֑ךְ אֶ֝בְיוֹנֶ֗יהָ אַשְׂבִּ֥יעַֽ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.en: I will abundantly bless her provision; I will give her needy bread in plenty.

verses.he: וְֽ֭כֹהֲנֶיהָ אַלְבִּ֣ישׁ יֶ֑שַׁע וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יהָ רַנֵּ֥ן יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.en: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation; And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

verses.he: שָׁ֤ם אַצְמִ֣יחַ קֶ֣רֶן לְדָוִ֑ד עָרַ֥כְתִּי נֵ֝֗ר לִמְשִׁיחִֽי׃
verses.en: There will I make a horn to shoot up unto David, There have I ordered a lamp for Mine anointed.

verses.he: א֭וֹיְבָיו אַלְבִּ֣ישׁ בֹּ֑שֶׁת וְ֝עָלָ֗יו יָצִ֥יץ נִזְרֽוֹ׃
verses.en: His enemies will I clothe with shame; But upon himself shall his crown shine.'
